change: Speciation rewritten; new options fission, protracted speciation, Red Queen and a user-defined environment (airmat)
outputs: Defaults: communities unchanged per seed; species IDs, and so the estimated species ages, change; new options only
evidence: stage 1: communities and trees identical, species ages differ

change: Fission assigned the wrong individuals to the new species
outputs: Only with fission: richness, age of new species, tree statistics
evidence: stage 1: fission crashes at this commit (Newick string with unequal parentheses), all other settings identical; from f31db2f to 67d1d6a (after the fix of cut-off phylogenies, #127) richness with fission about halved

change: User-defined environment (airmat) was assigned to the wrong cells on non-square grids
outputs: Only with a matrix airmat on non-square grids (not in the design)

change: Extinct lineages without living descendants are removed from the phylogeny during the run
outputs: Phylogeny in the output only; communities and indicators unchanged (they use the tree of the extant species)
evidence: stage 1: identical except the Colless index (polytomies resolved at random before #174)

change: With global dispersal the dying individual is no longer its own parent
outputs: Global dispersal: small changes of the communities; species ages and trait means
evidence: stage 1: results differ in exactly the settings with global dispersal; stage 2 pending

change: Phylogeny of extant species only; census half a generation after the events
outputs: Communities unchanged; gamma statistic, tree height and Colless index per seed
evidence: stage 1: communities identical, gamma, tree height and Colless index differ in nearly all settings; stage 2 (blocks environment and speciation, 30 replicates): none of 204 comparisons differs (false discovery rate 5%)

change: Default environmental gradient no longer exceeds 1 for an odd number of columns
outputs: Only odd grid widths with environmental filtering
evidence: stage 1: results differ only on the grid with 49 columns; stage 2 (block gridShape, 30 replicates): on that grid, conspecific neighbors (0.517 to 0.532) and cor(trait, environment) differ (2 of 26 comparisons, false discovery rate 5%)

change: Polytomies of the phylogeny are resolved deterministically
outputs: Colless index per seed; gamma unchanged
evidence: stage 1: identical except the Colless index

change: Fitness terms combined by proportional hazards on mortality and multiplied on reproduction instead of added; density renamed negativeDD; the absolute kernel averages over the k neighbors instead of dividing by k + 1; new kernels, positive density dependence and fitness on recruitment
outputs: Density dependence and its combination with environmental filtering: e.g. environment 0.5 + density 0.5, neutral before (about 20 species), has about 53 species; fewer conspecific neighbors; settings without density dependence unchanged
evidence: runs of the design at 852c61e (0.3.1) and 2331720, 30 replicates: 87 of 857 comparisons differ (false discovery rate 5%), all with density dependence; settings without density dependence give identical results per seed

change: R's random number generator in the C++ model
outputs: Other results per seed, distributions unchanged; results per seed no longer depend on the random number library of the compiler
